body: ![Season 14 Modpack Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24773effaa3a472e118fdda0bd59b33e2c7e7417.png) Season 14: Survival Forsaken takes place in the aftermath of a catastrophic collapse. What was once a thriving civilization has been reduced to ash and ruin, and something far worse has taken its place. A biological organism known as The Spore has awakened, spreading, adapting, and consuming everything in its path. This season transforms Minecraft into a post-apocalyptic survival experience, featuring a living infection mechanic that evolves as the season progresses, new dimensions, mobs, and environments shaped by the collapse, and a handpicked modpack built around immersion and performance. The world tells a story, and how that story ends depends on the players. Featured Mods: -Fungal Infection: A spreading alien intelligence with emergent infection mechanics, evolving threats, and the REDNIGHT narrative event -Vic's Point Blank: Full modern firearms arsenal, from pistols to rocket launchers -Create Aeronautics: Build and fly custom aircraft with Create's engineering systems -The Lost Cities: Explore sprawling ruined skyscraper cities reclaimed by nature -Zrikon's Military Armor: Tactical military-grade armor and equipment -More Biomes and Dimension Additions -As well as countless new mobs and enemies to fight -Complementary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches: Stunning shader-enhanced visuals Modpack Trailer: [Need a Server?, Check out Shockbyte Hosting, Use Code brandonX95 at checkout for 25% off your server](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=11286)
